description: This file defines data model classes for chart points and pie slices used in a Flutter expense tracking application, specifically for weekly charts and category pie charts.

classes.name: WeeklyChartPoint
classes.description: Represents a single point in a weekly expense chart with an index and an amount.

classes.name: CategoryPieSlice
classes.description: Represents a slice of a category pie chart, including name, color, and amount.

methods.name: WeeklyChartPoint
methods.description: Constructor for creating a weekly chart point with specified week index and expense amount.

methods.name: CategoryPieSlice
methods.description: Constructor for creating a pie slice with specified name, color, and amount.
